## Release checklist

Before merging this release PR:

- [ ] Verify the target Wazuh Manager is the same version or newer than the bundled agent.
- [ ] Add `Bundled Wazuh Agent: x.y.z-r` to this release's `wazuh-agent/CHANGELOG.md` entry.
- [ ] Add `Requires Wazuh Manager: x.y.z or newer` to the same release notes.
